# Department of Commerce total on-budget and off-budget outlays for FY 2016-2024
# From the FFO-3 table
outlays = {

    2024: 14831
}

# Verify we have FY 2016 - 2024 inclusive
years = list(range(2016, 2025))
print(f"Years: {years}")
print(f"Number of years: {len(years)}")

# Get values in order
values = [outlays[y] for y in years]
print(f"Values: {values}")

# Sort for quartile calculation
sorted_values = sorted(values)
print(f"Sorted values: {sorted_values}")

n = len(sorted_values)
print(f"n = {n}")

# Tukey exclusive median method:
# 1. Find the median (Q2)
# 2. For odd n, exclude the median when splitting
# 3. Q1 = median of lower half, Q3 = median of upper half

if n % 2 == 1:
    # Odd number of observations
    median_idx = n // 2  # 0-indexed
    median = sorted_values[median_idx]
    lower_half = sorted_values[:median_idx]  # exclude median
    upper_half = sorted_values[median_idx + 1:]  # exclude median
else:
    # Even number of observations
    median_idx = n // 2
    median = (sorted_values[median_idx - 1] + sorted_values[median_idx]) / 2
    lower_half = sorted_values[:median_idx]
    upper_half = sorted_values[median_idx:]

print(f"Median (Q2) = {median}")
print(f"Lower half: {lower_half}")
print(f"Upper half: {upper_half}")

# Q1 = median of lower half
m = len(lower_half)
if m % 2 == 1:
    Q1 = lower_half[m // 2]
else:
    Q1 = (lower_half[m // 2 - 1] + lower_half[m // 2]) / 2

# Q3 = median of upper half
m_upper = len(upper_half)
if m_upper % 2 == 1:
    Q3 = upper_half[m_upper // 2]
else:
    Q3 = (upper_half[m_upper // 2 - 1] + upper_half[m_upper // 2]) / 2

print(f"Q1 (Tukey exclusive) = {Q1}")
print(f"Q3 (Tukey exclusive) = {Q3}")

# Round to nearest hundredths
Q1_rounded = round(Q1, 2)
print(f"Q1 rounded to nearest hundredths: {Q1_rounded}")

# Write to file
print(f"\nFinal answer: {Q1_rounded}")
EOF
